cc:Work.dc:title: Compilation Programs
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest P91 B1 compilation across 23 sources. Bars and numeric labels show first checked-library request time excluding compiler import and API load. Diamond markers include those loading steps. Both ratios use the same-window TypeScript reference. Three fresh processes per role and source; process startup excluded. P90 checked parent B1 · separately measured.
